definitions.gloss: House of Councillors election; upper-house election
definitions.explanation: An election for the House of Councillors, the upper house of Japan's Diet. Held every three years, each time for half the seats, with six-year terms.

examples.japanese: {参院選|さんいんせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}づいて→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧きた。
examples.english: The upper-house election is drawing near.

examples.japanese: {参院選|さんいんせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{投票日|とうひょうび}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日曜日|にちようび}→日曜日：00656_nichiyoubi⟧だ。
examples.english: Voting day for the upper-house election is a Sunday.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{参院選|さんいんせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{投票率|とうひょうりつ}→投票率：22200_touhyouritsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In this upper-house election, attention is on the turnout among young people.

notes:
Short for ⟦{参議院|さんぎいん}→参議院：15158_sangiin⟧⟦{議員|ぎいん}→議員：02660_giin⟧⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧: ⟦{参院|さんいん}→参院：32725_sanin⟧ (the House of Councillors) + ⟦{選|せん}→選：09879_sen⟧ (election). A news word; the House of Councillors cannot be dissolved, so these elections come on a fixed schedule.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {参院選|さんいんせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立候補|りっこうほ}→立候補：13778_rikkouho⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to run in the upper-house election
- {参院選|さんいんせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧: the result of the upper-house election
- {参院選|さんいんせん}⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧: after the upper-house election

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{衆院選|しゅういんせん}→衆院選：32726_shuuinsen⟧: election for the House of Representatives, held when that house is dissolved or its term ends, and formally called a ⟦{総選挙|そうせんきょ}→総選挙：31300_sousenkyo⟧
